'''2000 Coventry Grand Slam Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed on 12 February 2000. It is known from Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d256">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-15-uk-grand-slam-13-2-00d256/ uk-grand-slam-13-2-00], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 15 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-15-uk-grand-slam-13-2-00d256/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Coventry Grand Slam]].

* '''Date:''' 12 February 2000
